name: podshare
description: Your team builds web pages and small apps together in one shared pod, each person from the AI app they already use.

interface.longDescription:
Podshare is where your team builds web pages and small apps together. A landing page, an event page, a class project, a client proposal, a feedback form: one person starts it, and everyone else picks it up from there.

Make a pod for a project and invite the people you work with. Each of you connects the AI app you already use and does your part of the same artifacts. Everyone sees who is working on what, talks and comments in the pod's channel, and carries on where someone else left off.

Work happens one region at a time, so several people can build one artifact at once without overwriting each other. Every change is kept in history. Nothing reaches anyone outside the pod until a person saves a version and makes it live.

With Podshare connected, you can ask to:
• See your pods, and what your team did since you last looked
• Create an artifact, or change part of one, in plain words
• Read and answer the comments your team left on an artifact
• Save a version, preview it, and make it live when you are ready
• Read what visitors sent through a form on a live artifact
• Get a link to share a saved version with anyone for 7 days

Group work, rebuilt for AI.
defaultPrompt: What pods do I have in Podshare, and what changed since I last looked?
Make a page for our book club where everyone can vote on next month's book
Make the changes my teammates asked for in their comments

positive.description: Lists the person's pods and what is in one
positive.prompt: What pods do I have in Podshare, and what's in sample-pod?
positive.expected_behavior: Names one pod, sample-pod, with its four artifacts (welcome, feedback, design-board, release-notes), says which are live, and mentions the two open comments.

positive.description: Changes part of an artifact in plain words
positive.prompt: In sample-pod, add a short 'Frequently asked questions' section to the end of the welcome artifact, with three questions a new team member might ask.
positive.expected_behavior: Adds one new region at the end of welcome's draft with three questions and answers, says the change is unsaved, and offers to save a version.

positive.description: Saves a version and makes it live, asking first
positive.prompt: Save a version of release-notes called 'First draft', then make it live.
positive.expected_behavior: Saves a version named 'First draft', asks the person to confirm before set_live because it is marked destructive, then gives release-notes' live address.

positive.description: Reads what visitors sent through a form
positive.prompt: What has been sent through the feedback form in sample-pod?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the one entry in the feedback form's inbox, with who sent it and when.

positive.prompt: Are there open comments in sample-pod? Make the change one of them asks for, then mark that comment addressed.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the two open comments, changes the region one of them points to, and marks that comment addressed with a reply saying what changed; a person still resolves it. If ChatGPT first proposes the change and asks, reply 'Go ahead' and it saves it.

negative.description: Weather has nothing to do with a pod
negative.prompt: What's the weather in Chicago tomorrow?

negative.description: Plain writing with nothing to build or share in a pod
negative.prompt: Write me a haiku about autumn.

negative.description: A private message, not a team's artifact
negative.prompt: Help me draft an email to my landlord about a leaky faucet.

publication.release_notes: Start from ChatGPT: choose a username, create a pod, and get a link to share a saved version with anyone for 7 days. Also adds studies, to put saved versions in front of people and read what they did.
